hub.speaker: Krshia
hub.text: Hrr. My crate — gone from the storeroom three nights past. Sewers, I think. Scavengers do not knock first.

text_variants.text: You come back. Any word on my crate?
Crate is home. You, I will remember. Yes.
You have the look of someone come to ask a favor. Speak plainly — I have no patience for the other kind.
The inn's order, extended. For the barmaid's sake, and yours. Do not make a habit of it.

options.text: The scavengers dragged it into a cellar — I've seen it myself. (Light)

options._comment: Content Wave C4 (Q2 TALK path): the smooth-over. Progress-gated on heard_wrong_order (HIDDEN until Lyonette gives the quest), hidden once resolved -- so it never appears to crate_talk/social_loop/gate_district (which never bank heard_wrong_order). Banks the shared resolved_wrong_order (beat 1) + smoothed_with_krshia (Lyonette's TALK report gate) + persuaded_someone (the [Diplomat] identity feed, now a THIRD producer alongside watch_crate + zevara).
options.text: The inn's order ran short. Extend it on a good word — for Lyonette's sake. (Persuade)

options._comment: Economy v1 D2: Krshia's shop entry. ALWAYS-visible, ALWAYS-unlocked navigation option (window-shopping is content); no gold requires, so it never greys. Placed at array index 4 -- AFTER the pitch/guile/report/smooth options so the first-visible option (pitch fresh / report post-fight / smooth for wrong_order) stays at visible position 0 for every confirm-at-0 script. The buy options with their gold gate live in the 'shop' node.

shop.speaker: Krshia
shop.text: Silverfang goods — best in Liscor, and I will hear no argument on it. Cheapest at the front, the good stock where a browsing hand drifts. Coin on the counter and it is yours. No discounts, no haggling. I remember faces.
shop._comment: Economy v1 D2 shop node. Each buy option pairs requires:{gold:price} (greys VISIBLE when broke -- D1's numeric M4 gate, never hidden) WITH effects:[{gold:-price},{item:id}] (the buy contract: the requires gate is what guarantees the unconditional effect-list spend can never refuse while still granting the item). Gear/tool items only -- no consumable machinery. Prices in items.json; price bar (design 2026-07-05 s2/s5): a day's honest inn work (~4 gold) buys the entry charm in a day or two; the jerkin takes several. Price numerals in option text are diegetic (gold is a countable object per the ratified design, NOT a hidden stat -- opacity forbids STR/DEX, not coin).

options.text: That Silverfang hunting knife — good steel. (15 gold)
The wool-lined cloak. The wet gets in, out on the road. (18 gold)

bought.speaker: Krshia
bought.text: Sold. Wear it, use it — and do not bring it back to me broken expecting sympathy. Anything else catch your eye?

accepted.speaker: Krshia
accepted.text: Good. Sewer grates, south of here — start there. Careful of teeth.

thanks.speaker: Krshia
thanks.text: Hrr. Yes. This is mine. My thanks — do not expect a discount, but my thanks.

smoothed.speaker: Krshia
smoothed.text: Hrr. For the barmaid, then. She is prickly, that one, but she works — I have watched her learn it. The order goes out full, and no word of the shortfall reaches Erin from my stall. You speak plainly and you speak for a friend. That, I respect.
